author: Scott Manley
description:
NASA cancelled the lunar gateway, but one component of the gateway will be going to deep space in the form of Space Reactor 1 - Freedom. This mission on one had will be the first of its kind demonstrator of nuclear electric propulsion, but simultaneously much less ambitious than NASA's first grant design for a nuclear electric mission, Jupiter Icy Moons Orbiter, the result of the Prometheus Project.

But, unlike the massively ambitions JIMO, this actually stands a chance of flying, it may be thrown together with bits that were easily available, but actually getting to space and demonstrating the technology is more important than designing a great mission that never flies.
